turnaround_reason: CX/BPO outsourcer beaten down ~48% off highs on fears that generative AI structurally shrinks the seat-based contact-center business it bought Webhelp to scale. Trades at ~2.2x forward earnings and 0.58x book on ~$1B/yr FCF, a valuation that prices in secular decline; the bull case is that AI becomes a services tailwind (iX Suite deals +400% YoY) rather than a replacement.
bullish_points: Extremely cheap: ~2.2x forward P/E, 0.58x book, EV/EBITDA ~5.4x, ~$775M TTM FCF against a $1.56B market cap
iX Suite / agentic-AI deals up 400% YoY - early evidence AI is additive to the services mix, not purely cannibalistic
CEO Caldwell and CFO both bought stock in open market (small but directionally bullish) in 2026
Analyst mean target $36.25 vs $25.53 spot (~42% implied); lone recommendation reads 'buy'
bearish_points: Secular AI overhang on seat-based CX is the whole reason it's cheap - a value trap risk, not a cyclical dip
Heavy leverage: total debt $5.5B, debt/equity ~204%, EV $6.9B vs $1.56B equity - most of the enterprise value is debt
Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (10%+ holder) dumped 6M shares (~$133M) in April 2026 - large informed seller
Revenue growth barely positive (+1.9%); Q3 consensus EPS already cut 8% over 90 days ($3.06 -> $2.81)
Reported net profit margin negative (-13%) on GAAP (goodwill/amortization from Webhelp), optics remain poor
catalyst: Q3 FY2026 earnings after the close on Sep 29, 2026 - guidance on AI deal conversion, revenue trajectory, and deleveraging pace will re-rate or re-break the stock
suggested_trade: Spot only, small starter; do NOT chase into the print. Wait for post-earnings reaction - a guide-down flush toward $20 or a relief pop are both playable, but sizing into a binary at 2x P/E cuts both ways given the leverage.
key_risk: AI genuinely deflates the core seat-based CX business faster than iX Suite/services can offset, turning cheap into permanently cheap while $5.5B of debt compounds the equity risk.
would_skip_if: You need liquid options (near-worthless here) or you can't stomach a levered value-trap; also skip buying into the Sep 29 print blind.
